availability: All fields are implemented numeric/enum observations, including genuine model-specific zero invariants. Capture is not authority. Fast thread confinement still applies after closure; fast pool/arena/region GetStatistics requires active authority while their structural captures remain available. Synchronized and direct terminal observations preserve their defined histories.
oracleScope: Public unsuppressed consumer paths compare both complete schemas for builder growth/completion, workspace publication/entered processing/reset, typed slab live/idle trim, prepared aligned ordinary/scoped arena reuse, lexical region cleanup and synchronized reference roots. Immutable owner IDs and the process measurement identity are observed; all expected gauges and histories derive from declared operations. Entered callbacks, injected failures, retirement/quarantine, provider ranges, saturation, finalization and internal synchronized region checks are separately linked local proofs, not invented packaged authority.
unreviewedScope: These 47 field definitions and representative complete snapshots do not close every API/lifecycle/exception combination, layouts, generated safety schedules, material-benefit and diagnostic-cost evidence, final native platforms or release delivery.

schemas.scope: One actual owner and its storage/lifecycle model. NAM-owned extents include known headers/backend padding, not opaque allocator overhead or RSS. Borrowed provider ranges are separate. Same lineage across generations is not a second allocation.
schemas.consistency: Synchronized capture holds the lifecycle gate but entered fast-lane operations may advance independently; exact cross-field and cross-snapshot reconciliation needs quiescent producers. Fast captures require the construction thread; direct builder capture excludes an entered operation. Workspace owner-thread captures can observe its entered Process range.
schemas.resetPolicy: Peaks and completed owner histories survive trim, reset/recycle, generations and terminal cleanup, independently of process measurement reset. Current gauges follow actual storage authority. Completion transfers a builder's backing out of its current gauges without falsely freeing the budget charge.
schemas.historyOverflow: Completed acquisition/trim histories saturate when their model can exceed long representation. An append-only lexical region derives acquisition history from its checked int backing identity, so exhaustion occurs before long history overflow and HistoryOverflowed is genuinely false. Exact backing, usable and logical gauges remain maintained; identities cannot wrap.

fields.name: Lifecycle
fields.definition: Actual active/unleased/returned/disposed gate state, not inferred from nonzero backing; numeric observation cannot reopen storage.
fields.overflow: Finite gate transitions, no ownership resurrection.

fields.name: Generation
fields.definition: Synchronized current/most recent generation or fast arena epoch; lexical regions, fast pools and direct owners have a true zero invariant. Generation changes do not replace stable OwnerId.
fields.overflow: Checked non-reusing generation/epoch exhaustion rejects before publication.

fields.name: RequestedBytes
fields.definition: Published initialized logical demand except fast arena occupied bump bytes also include inter-range alignment and pending initialization. Workspace Process temporarily reports its entered already-initialized range, not persistent publication.
fields.overflow: Checked bounded live demand, never reconstructed from histories.

fields.name: RetainedBytes
fields.definition: Complete known NAM extents in the current storage bank, including headers/padding; excludes retired/quarantined banks and borrowed payload. Direct completion clears builder ownership but not transferred physical storage.
fields.overflow: Checked actual acquired extents, not logical length or RSS.

fields.name: RetiredBytes
fields.definition: Complete known extents in retired or quarantined banks until actual drain/free/rejoin. These remain part of OutstandingNativeBytes; do not add them as another charge.
fields.overflow: Checked exact sum of actual retained generation extents.

fields.name: SegmentCount
fields.definition: Current physical slabs, whole prepared pages or bump segments, including attached external segments; a direct owner has at most one block. Does not count logical arena leases or metadata records.
fields.overflow: Checked/bank-bounded segment count.

fields.name: AvailableSegmentCount
fields.definition: Completely idle current slabs/pages/bump segments, not free slots/bytes or active-segment slack. Direct owners count their unused active block; entered workspace use is not idle.
fields.overflow: Exact nonnegative subset of retained current segments.

fields.name: RetiredSegmentCount
fields.definition: Segments held by retired and quarantined generations, unavailable to ordinary acquisition until successful drain/rejoin. Fast/direct owners have no such banks and report verified zero.
fields.overflow: Checked exact retired/quarantined bank sum.

fields.name: TrimmedBytes
fields.definition: Owner-lifetime sum of complete known extents physically freed by explicit trim, not logical returns, idle capacity or final disposal. Lexical/direct owners have no trim operation and real zero.
fields.overflow: Saturates; exact physical free and budget relief continue.

fields.name: TrimCallCount
fields.definition: Completed explicit owner trim invocations, including successful zero-release calls while live storage prevents removal; independent of process reset.
fields.overflow: Saturating history with sticky owner flag.

fields.name: FreshSegmentAllocationCount
fields.definition: Owner-lifetime successful fresh backing-segment acquisitions, not reuse or builder realloc. Prepared page acquisitions count pages; direct builder counts its initial block once. Append-only lexical region uses its checked backing count without duplicate history state and preserves it through terminal cleanup.
fields.overflow: Saturates separately from identities where reachable. Lexical region's checked int ordinal exhausts before long overflow; unsuccessful admission or backend acquisition does not advance it.

fields.name: HistoryOverflowed
fields.definition: At least one owner lifetime completed history exceeded exact representation. Reaching maximum exactly is not overflow by itself. Lexical region's only acquisition history is bounded by checked int backing identity and is genuinely never overflowing, not disabled accounting.
fields.overflow: Sticky where reachable; lexical bounded identity exhaustion rejects before admission. Exact current gauges and cleanup remain valid.

fields.name: Model
fields.definition: Actual thread-confined pool/region/arena, synchronized pool/region/arena, single-writer builder or thread-confined workspace; zero fields must be explained by this actual model.
fields.overflow: Finite immutable model.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.definition: Immutable non-address lineage assigned once; generations, aliases, trim and terminal observations retain it. No global owner registry or lifetime grant.
fields.overflow: Checked positive non-wrapping owner construction.

fields.name: UsableCapacityBytes
fields.definition: Current exposed owned payload capacity, excluding native headers, tail/stride padding and borrowed ranges. Prepared page totals use slot capacity, not complete page extent.
fields.overflow: Checked bank capacity sum distinct from backing charge.

fields.name: BorrowedBytes
fields.definition: Provider-owned ranges retained by the current bank and not charged as invented NAM native payload; fast mapped owner retains the complete registered provider obligation until actual release.
fields.overflow: Checked registered range extents.

fields.name: RetiredBorrowedBytes
fields.definition: Actual provider-owned range capacity held in retired/quarantined banks; distinct from RetiredBytes NAM extent accounting. Draining/rejoin transfers the obligation, not a physical NAM payload free.
fields.overflow: Checked actual retired provider-range sum.

fields.name: OutstandingNativeBytes
fields.definition: Actual acquired known extents for this owner across current, retired, quarantined and detached storage until physical release, excluding provider payload/opaque overhead. Completion removes direct builder authority into the unique control.
fields.overflow: Checked acquisition/free accounting; not sum of saturated histories.

fields.name: DetachedNativeBytes
fields.definition: Subset of owner outstanding extents detached to actual finalization responsibility, including still-live old generation storage. Not an immediate deterministic free or extra charge.
fields.overflow: Checked subset updated at actual detach/finalizer boundaries.

fields.name: PeakOutstandingNativeBytes
fields.definition: Recorded highest acquired extent at successful acquisition boundaries, including backing freed after failed publication; not budget-wide peak or opaque realloc overlap. Survives terminal cleanup and process reset.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum of independently maintained checked extent gauge.

fields.name: InitializedPayloadBytes
fields.definition: Fully initialized live payload, excluding padding and unpublished producer ranges. Alias/materialization adds no demand. Workspace Process reports actual bounded entered use of previously initialized reusable storage.
fields.overflow: Checked live demand; not reconstruction from snapshot padding.

fields.name: PeakInitializedPayloadBytes
fields.definition: Recorded highest successful published initialized demand, plus real entered workspace Process demand; survives later producer failure, reset/recycle and cleanup. Failed unpublished prefix cannot invent successful demand.
fields.overflow: Exact lifetime maximum independent of current range and event-history saturation.

schemas.scope: Value-only owner structural metadata, actual lineage and backing/logical histories. Records are runtime metadata, not necessarily each arena lease; no pointer/owner authority is retained.
schemas.consistency: Lifecycle-gated synchronized or construction-thread fast capture; entered operations may still progress. Capture at quiescent maintenance boundaries for multi-snapshot reconciliation. Finalizers may independently debit detached storage.
schemas.resetPolicy: MetricsEpoch changes only at internal process measurement reset. Generation/scope epochs follow owner transitions. Actual current and retired/quarantine bank counts follow resource state; lifetime backing/logical peaks and owner histories survive closure.
schemas.historyOverflow: Sticky owner flag mirrors real lifetime-history saturation, never relaxed structural cleanup. All current counts/extent gauges remain exact; checked owner/generation/epoch identities cannot silently wrap.

fields.name: Lifecycle
fields.definition: Actual owner gate state even when storage remains detached or retired; observation is not payload authority.
fields.overflow: Finite valid owner transitions.

fields.name: Generation
fields.definition: Current/most recent synchronized generation or fast arena epoch; actual zero for nongenerational lexical/direct/pool models, not unavailable private-runtime telemetry.
fields.overflow: Checked non-reusing transition identity.

fields.name: ScopeEpoch
fields.definition: Actual scoped lifetime epoch of current generation/fast arena, changed by recycle/reset; zero without a current synchronized generation or any scoped mechanism.
fields.overflow: Checked epoch exhaustion closes/rejects before reuse.

fields.name: MetricsEpoch
fields.definition: Actual process accounting epoch sampled at capture, not an owner generation and not reset by public observation. Owner lifetime histories remain independent.
fields.overflow: Checked internal epoch reset rejects before mutation.

fields.name: ActiveRecords
fields.definition: Actual active allocation/transfer/materialized composite records plus grouped synchronized scoped lane, or fast pool initializing/live slots/direct block control. Fast region/arena use no per-range records and genuinely report zero.
fields.overflow: Checked metadata bank sum.

fields.name: ScopedRecords
fields.definition: Actual scoped records plus grouped synchronized scoped lane and scoped composite materializations; direct/fast models without per-range records report genuine zero.
fields.overflow: Checked current metadata bank sum.

fields.name: ReferenceRoots
fields.definition: Actual current generation roots protecting native reference slots. Unmanaged thread-confined models have no reference-root bank, not missing measurement.
fields.overflow: Actual bounded current root collection count.

fields.name: OrdinaryTraversalIndex
fields.definition: Actual ordinary bump search frontier, fast pool returned-slab cache candidate, or fast bump current segment index. Minus one means no candidate/current generation or direct nontraversing model, not an invented zero.
fields.overflow: Actual bank index/sentinel, checked traversal.

fields.name: ScopedTraversalIndex
fields.definition: Actual reverse synchronized scoped search frontier or fast arena scoped-lane segment index. Minus one is genuine absence of candidate/mechanism.
fields.overflow: Actual index/sentinel and bounded bank traversal.

fields.name: RetainedSegmentCount
fields.definition: Actual current slabs/pages/bump segments including attached external backing, not active record count or number of views. Direct owner has at most one block.
fields.overflow: Checked sum of current storage banks.

fields.name: AvailableSegmentCount
fields.definition: Current completely idle slabs/pages or bump segments. Closed fast owners have no reuse authority, even if finalizable storage remains; entered workspace use is not idle.
fields.overflow: Exact current idle subset, not history reconstruction.

fields.name: RetiredGenerationCount
fields.definition: Actual generations awaiting entered-use/control drain, excluding quarantine. No generational retirement mechanism in fast/direct owners gives verified zero.
fields.overflow: Actual bounded bank count.

fields.name: RetiredSegmentCount
fields.definition: Segments in both retired and quarantined generation banks, unavailable for ordinary reuse until drain succeeds; quarantine subset is not another physical count.
fields.overflow: Checked bank sum.

fields.name: RetiredBytes
fields.definition: Complete known extent in retired/quarantined banks; borrowed provider payload remains separate and logical return cannot forgive physical charge.
fields.overflow: Checked exact retired extent sum.

fields.name: QuarantinedGenerationCount
fields.definition: Actual ended generations whose failed drain removed their storage from reusable banks; excludes ordinary awaiting-drain retirement.
fields.overflow: Actual bounded quarantine bank count.

fields.name: QuarantinedSegmentCount
fields.definition: Actual segments belonging to quarantined ended generations, a subset of RetiredSegmentCount; remain physically charged until genuine cleanup.
fields.overflow: Checked exact quarantine bank sum.

fields.name: CurrentGenerationQuarantined
fields.definition: Actual flag of the current generation only, not whether any old quarantined generation exists. Old quarantine can be nonzero while this flag is genuinely false; absent current generation is false.
fields.overflow: Boolean actual current state, not inferred from bank count.

fields.name: HistoryOverflowed
fields.definition: Owner-wide real completed-history saturation; structural current gauges remain measured rather than discarded or replaced with zero.
fields.overflow: Sticky through trim and terminal cleanup.

fields.name: Model
fields.definition: Immutable actual owner model explaining its structural mechanisms and genuine absences; default Unspecified means no runtime owner supplied that default value.
fields.overflow: Finite immutable model.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.definition: Stable actual allocator identity independent of generation/measurement epoch or numeric terminal observation; not a native address or usable authority.
fields.overflow: Checked positive non-wrapping owner construction.

fields.name: OutstandingNativeBytes
fields.definition: Actual owner-acquired extents across current/retired/quarantined/detached storage, including known headers/padding and excluding provider payload/opaque overhead. Numeric snapshot owns none of it.
fields.overflow: Checked physical accounting independent of saturated histories.

fields.name: DetachedNativeBytes
fields.definition: Actual subset whose physical return is detached to finalization; keeping the owner or a numeric snapshot alive does not pretend the bytes were freed.
fields.overflow: Checked subset at actual detach/free transitions.

fields.name: PeakOutstandingNativeBytes
fields.definition: Real owner peak recorded at successful acquisition, even when later publication fails; independent of shared-domain peak and measurement reset, and preserved after cleanup.
fields.overflow: Exact lifetime maximum of checked physical gauge.

fields.name: InitializedPayloadBytes
fields.definition: Current initialized live or explicitly entered workspace demand, excluding padding and unpublished producer data. Numeric observation and extra aliases add no bytes.
fields.overflow: Checked actual active initialized gauge.

fields.name: PeakInitializedPayloadBytes
fields.definition: Recorded highest initialized active demand across lifetimes, including workspace entered range; failed unpublished initialization does not create successful demand and terminal cleanup does not erase history.
fields.overflow: Exact recorded lifetime maximum independent of current storage.
